shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- App.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- main.tsx ---\\n' && cat src/main.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'gravity-ui/(markdown|codemirror)|marked|react-markdown' package-lock.json | head -50; cat index.html; cat vite.config.ts"

/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/components@4.10.0 peerDependencies --json; npm view @gravity-ui/markdown-editor@15.49.0 peerDependencies --json; npm view @gravity-ui/components versions --json | tail -5; npm view @gravity-ui/uikit versions --json | tail -5'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify({exports:p.exports,types:p.types,main:p.main,module:p.module},null,2))\"; rg -n \"class MarkdownEditor|new MarkdownEditor|presets\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/lib -g '*.d.ts' | head -30; rg -n \"export .*YFM|YFMUI|Editor\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/lib/index.d.ts | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- React editor types ---\\n'; sed -n '1,160p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/Editor.d.ts 2>/dev/null || rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view | head"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"renderPreview\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/*.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/**/*.js | grep -v Toolbar | head -40; rg -n \"class Renderer|render\\(\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/extensions/behavior/ReactRenderer/*.js | head -20; rg -n \"new ReactRenderStorage|reactRenderer\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/wysiwyg-preset.js | head -10"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/styles; ls node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib | head -20; rg -n \"\\.css\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/MarkdownEditorView.js | head -10; rg -n \"createMarkupEditor|markup.*preset|preset.*markup\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/wysiwyg-preset.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/types.d.ts | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"renderPreview\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/bundle/wysiwyg-preset.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm -g '*.js' | grep -v bundle | head -40; rg -n \"Renderer|reactRenderer\" node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/lib/index.js | head -20; rg -rn \"renderPreview\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/README.md | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc 'rg -n "sanitize-html" node_modules/@diplodoc/transform/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json | head; ls node_modules/sanitize-html/package.json node_modules/cheerio/package.json node_modules/cssfilter/package.json node_modules/css/package.json 2>/dev/null'

/bin/bash -lc 'ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/components; rg -rn "transform" node_modules/@gravity-ui/components/build/esm/utils/markdown* 2>/dev/null | head -5; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/components -name "*.d.ts" | xargs rg -ln "transform" 2>/dev/null | head -5'

/bin/bash -lc "grep -n 'node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor' package-lock.json | head; node -e \"const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/package.json'); console.log(p.version); console.log(Object.keys(p.peerDependencies).length)\"; rg -n \"@gravity-ui/markdown-editor\" package-lock.json | head -5"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/markdown-editor/build/esm/view/hooks/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; rg -n \"useThemeValue\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/hooks/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; rg -rn \"useThemeValue\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' -l | head -3"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@types/cheerio 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@types/sanitize-html 2>/dev/null; rg -n \"\\\"@types/sanitize-html\\\"|\\\"@types/cheerio\\\"\" package.json package-lock.json | head -5"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -rn \"g-root\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --type js | head -3; rg -rn \"g-root\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '"'!*.map'"' | head -3"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff src/App.tsx | head -60; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -5'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E "error|Error" | head -5; echo "build exit: $?"'
